title: Close with a reason
summary: WebSockets: Close with a reason. Use a different short close reason.
introduction: A close frame can carry a code and short reason. Code 1000 means a normal close.
learningObjectives: Close with a reason with WebSockets
Use a different short close reason

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Close with a reason

blocks.text: The server sends a normal-close code 1000 and reason Done. The client prints both from its close event.
Use a different short close reason.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A close event means messages can no longer be sent on that connection.
